meta_description_en: Outlet #027 editorial: bugfix for Jacksoft, Randscaper landscape generator, Molgrum 3D update, and disc exchange policy notes.
meta_description_ru: Колонка редакции Outlet #027: исправление для Jacksoft, программа Randscaper, обновление Molgrum 3D и правила обмена дисков по почте.
body_en_plain:
Most of the few bugs in JACKSOFT
(Issue 12) have now been cured
thanks to Paul Preston who has
sent in the mod(SAVEd as JACKMOD
in this issue). MERGE it into
JACKSOFT and reSAVE the program.
You will also find the colour is
now black INK on yellow PAPER.

RANDSCAPER in this issue"paints"
a different landscape depending
on what word or phrase you type
in. Some are great but others
somewhat less than artistic!
However, since there are several
billion possible pictures...!!
Anyway, write in if you discover
any words that give particularly
interesting landscapes!


In OUTLET 25 we did a review of
Ian Hughes' excellent MOLGRUM 3D
graphics program. The only minor
criticism was finding the routes
to the different menus in the
program. Ian now provides a menu
map with MOLGRUM to clarify the
menus thus perfecting an already
marvellous program.

Finally, note that we ARE going
to continue with our"user's own"
disc/cartridge option but it is
possible you may not ALWAYS get
your own disc back if we take
one straight from stock to speed
up the ordering process.However,
this does mean that any discs or
cartridges received in very bad
condition (damaged or with tacky
labels hanging off etc.) could
delay your order as they must be
put aside for individual attent-
ion to ensure the sender gets
his own back in such cases.


       Ron & Brian Cavers

body_en:
## Editorial

Most of the few bugs in JACKSOFT (Issue 12) have now been cured thanks to Paul Preston who has sent in the mod (SAVEd as JACKMOD in this issue). MERGE it into JACKSOFT and reSAVE the program. You will also find the colour is now black INK on yellow PAPER.

RANDSCAPER in this issue "paints" a different landscape depending on what word or phrase you type in. Some are great but others somewhat less than artistic! However, since there are several billion possible pictures...!! Anyway, write in if you discover any words that give particularly interesting landscapes!

In OUTLET 25 we did a review of Ian Hughes' excellent MOLGRUM 3D graphics program. The only minor criticism was finding the routes to the different menus in the program. Ian now provides a menu map with MOLGRUM to clarify the menus thus perfecting an already marvellous program.

Finally, note that we ARE going to continue with our "user's own" disc/cartridge option but it is possible you may not ALWAYS get your own disc back if we take one straight from stock to speed up the ordering process. However, this does mean that any discs or cartridges received in very bad condition (damaged or with tacky labels hanging off etc.) could delay your order as they must be put aside for individual attention to ensure the sender gets his own back in such cases.

Ron & Brian Cavers  
CHEZRON SOFTWARE  
605, Loughborough Road  
Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ.
body_ru:
## От редакции

Большинство из немногих ошибок в JACKSOFT (выпуск 12) исправлено благодаря Paul Preston, который прислал патч (SAVEd как JACKMOD в этом номере). Сделайте MERGE в JACKSOFT и снова reSAVE. Также вы увидите, что цвета стали черный INK на желтом PAPER.

RANDSCAPER в этом выпуске «рисует» разные пейзажи в зависимости от введенного слова или фразы. Одни отличные, другие далеки от шедевров! Впрочем, учитывая, что вариантов несколько миллиардов! В общем, пишите нам, если найдете слова, создающие особенно интересные пейзажи!

В OUTLET 25 мы делали обзор прекрасной программы 3D-графики MOLGRUM от Ian Hughes. Единственной мелкой придиркой был поиск путей к разным меню программы. Теперь Ian прикладывает к MOLGRUM схему меню для наглядности, доводя и без того замечательную программу до совершенства.

И наконец, мы ДЕЙСТВИТЕЛЬНО продолжаем принимать диски и картриджи пользователей, но вы не ВСЕГДА получите назад именно свой диск, если мы берем диск со склада ради ускорения выполнения заказа. Однако это означает, что диски или картриджи в очень плохом состоянии (поврежденные, с болтающимися липкими этикетками и т.д.) могут задержать заказ: их придется отложить для отдельной обработки, чтобы отправитель в таких случаях получил назад именно свой носитель.

```text
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.
```
